decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">The
proposed externally illuminated free standing sign, by reason of its siting and scale, would result in an obtrusive and incongruous appearance, which would
fail to respect the character of the locality and the street scene. It would
therefore fail to preserve public visual amenity, contrary to the National
Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy D8 of The London Plan (2021), and Policies DM1 and DM5 of the Development
Management Policies Local plan (2013) .</p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">The
externally illuminated free-standing advertisement sign, by reason of its
siting, proximity to the front bay window of the adjoining residential property
at No. 97 Marsh Lane, and its external illumination, would result in
unacceptable harm to the residential amenity of neighbouring occupiers through
increased light spill and visual intrusion. The proposal is therefore contrary
to the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy D8 of the London Plan
(2021), and Policies DM1 and DM5 of the Development Management Policies Local
plan (2013).<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>
description: Advertisement Consent Renewal: Display of one externally illuminated free-standing sign and two non-illuminated fascia signs (retrospective)
